title: White Miso Butterscotch Custard Ice Cream
changes_from_base: Butter and dark brown sugar cooked to a butterscotch, white miso whisked in for a salty-savoury edge, a little cinnamon; no added salt.
summary: A version of our classic custard where butter and dark brown sugar are cooked into a butterscotch and white miso brings a salty, savoury edge instead of added salt. Rich and moreish.

steps.title: Make the butterscotch
steps.text: Melt the butter in the saucepan over medium-low heat, stir in the dark brown sugar, then turn up the heat and cook for 2-3 min until it smells toasted.

steps.title: Add the dairy
steps.text: Whisk in the cream, milk and miso and bring to a bare simmer, whisking so the miso dissolves fully.

steps.title: Temper
steps.text: Beat the yolks in the heatproof bowl and add a third of the hot butterscotch dairy a ladle at a time, whisking, then return to the pan and lower the heat.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Stir until the custard thickens enough to coat the spatula, at 77-80 °C.

steps.title: Season and chill
steps.text: Off the heat, whisk in the vanilla and cinnamon, strain and cool over the iced water. Refrigerate for at least 4 h.

steps.title: Churn and freeze
steps.text: Churn until thick. It comes out very soft, so give it 4-5 h in the freezer.

tips: Choose white (shiro) miso for a mild flavour, and check the label for any added alcohol.
A common mistake is adding extra salt; miso is already salty, so taste the chilled base first.
Lovely with sliced banana or a warm brownie.
storage: Freeze in a covered container for up to 2 weeks.
